hypidiomorphic.definition:
a. Partly idiomorphic; -- said of rock a portion only
   of whose constituents have a distinct crystalline form.

hyping.definition:
-ing form of hyp
n. An abbreviation of hypochonaria; -- usually in plural.
v. t. To make melancholy.
hyping.translation:
(hyp 的现在分词) <废> n.忧郁, 疑病
v. 使忧郁

hypinosis.definition:
n. A diminution in the normal amount of fibrin present in
   the blood.
